reason: I don't know who you are, and paying a website I just met by card with promises of refunds is exactly how my friend lost money to an agency. The local agencies and my child's IELTS centre already help us for free, so I'd use your free search and maybe the one practice application, but not pay.
objection: Refund promises online mean nothing to me - who do I call in Tashkent or Almaty if you disappear with my $99? And Common App and UCAS are mostly for the US and UK; I am not sure you really know Canada and Europe scholarships well.
would_change_my_mind: A real parent I know, from my city, telling me their child used it and it caught a mistake the agency missed - plus being able to pay locally (Kaspi/Click/Payme) instead of an international card.
